title: Frequency set decomposition equivalence
statement: For a finite coordinate set $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, there is a bijection between pairs $(A,B)$, where $A$ is a subset of $J$ and $B$ is a subset of the indices outside $J$, and subsets of $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$.
